# ADUX Daily · 2026-08-24
**① Bird taps Segway for its next-gen shared fleet**
> **EN** Bird and Segway announced a partnership to roll out a next-generation shared micromobility fleet across North America, putting Segway's commercial-grade vehicles and connected platform at the core of Bird's operations.
> **中文** Bird 与 Segway 宣布合作，在北美部署下一代共享微出行车队：赛格威的商用级车辆与联网平台将成为 Bird 运营的核心。
> **한국어** Bird가 세그웨이와 손잡고 북미 전역에 차세대 공유 플릿을 배치. 세그웨이의 상용 차량과 커넥티드 플랫폼이 운영의 핵심이 된다.

[▸ Segway Commercial](https://b2b.segway.com/blog/bird-and-segway-partner-to-launch-next-gen-shared-micromobility-fleet-across-north-america/)

━━━━━━━━━━━━━

**② Segway opens $350 pre-orders for the kids' S2**
> **EN** Segway put the Ninebot S2 kids' self-balancing scooter on pre-order at $350 after a $100 launch discount — extending the self-balancing line down to its youngest riders yet.
> **中文** 赛格威开启 Ninebot S2 儿童平衡车预售，立减 100 美元后售价 350 美元——平衡车产品线首次下探到低龄用户。
> **한국어** 나인봇 S2 키즈 셀프밸런싱 스쿠터가 100달러 할인된 350달러에 예약 판매 시작. 밸런싱 라인업이 가장 어린 사용자층까지 확장됐다.

[▸ 9to5Toys](https://9to5toys.com/2026/08/18/segway-ninebot-s2-kids-self-balancing-scooter-pre-order-350/)
